organizerEmail.description: The organizer of the gift exchange. Overwritten with the authenticated caller before the request is handled.

hatId.description: The gift exchange the participant belongs to

email.description: The address the participant is recorded at, used to find them

name.description: The name to call them by. A name belongs to the person, so this is what they are called in every gift exchange they take part in. The handler's validator is what restricts the characters: the gateway compares patterns with ECMA 262 regex, which has no Unicode property escapes, so the rule as written would reject the very names it exists to allow.
